basis: Iziko's governance page names it a Schedule 3A Public Entity and agency of the national department under the Cultural Institutions Act, and its 2025/26 annual report (page 54) lists Council approval of annual budgets, page 8 names the Auditor-General as external auditor and page 100 lists Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act compliance.
The About Us page lists a Board of Trustees and the Beyond The Art page calls the Foundation a registered public benefit organisation.

The privacy policy names The Zeitz MOCAA Foundation Trust as the museum, the Global Council page calls it an independent, non-profit organization, and a 4 June 2026 media release names its Board of Trustees.
The About Us page calls the Bag Factory a non-profit contemporary visual art organisation and the Board page lists its chairperson and board.

red_tape.note: In a November 2024 press release the Johannesburg Heritage Foundation and Friends of the Johannesburg Art Gallery write that timely decision making at the gallery is hindered by a complicated hierarchy of managers, directors, executives and governing bodies, and cite the City of Johannesburg's complicated bureaucracy and opaque tender processes.
